source_title: Air India introduces new amenity kits inspired by Indian art and wellness - ET TravelWorld
source_excerpt: Air India has introduced a new collection of amenity kits and loungewear for passengers travelling on its international flights, incorporating Indian art, traditional craftsmanship and wellness-inspired elements into its onboard experience.Launching from October 2026, the collection has been developed in collaboration with Forest Essentials and includes skincare and fragrance products, alongside a handcrafted Ayurvedic Marma massager. The amenity kits and loungewear will be available on flights exceeding eight hours and overnight flights lasting more than six hours.The First Class collection, called The Art of Flight, draws inspiration from Gond art and features original artwork created exclusively for the airline by artist Dwarka Paraste. The kits will have different designs for outbound and inbound journeys, with Ivory Cream used on flights departing India and Antique White on flights arriving in the country. The artwork and colour palette will be refreshed every six months, creating a collectible series.The First Class kits include Forest Essentials products such as Light Day Lotion with SPF 30, Facial Tonic Mist, Lip Cream, Ultra-Rich Body Milk and perfume. Travel essentials include socks, an eye mask, earplugs, a dental kit and a hair tie.Rajesh Dogra, Chief Customer Experience Officer at Air India, said, “At Air India, every element of the journey is an opportunity to make our guests feel cared for, comfortable and connected to the warmth of India. Our new amenity kits and loungewear have been thoughtfully designed to go beyond functionality, weaving together India's rich traditions of art, craftsmanship and wellness with the expectations of the modern global traveller.”Business Class passengers will receive kits from the Navratna Collection, inspired by the nine gems of Indian tradition. The kits feature nine colour variations and are presented in a Jharoka-shaped bag made from premium PU leather. Coral kits will be offered on flights departing India, while Ruby kits will be available on inbound flights.The Business Class kits contain Forest Essentials Lip Cream, Ultra-Rich Body Milk and perfume, along with travel essentials similar to those offered in First Class.Both First and Business Class passengers will also receive a handcrafted Marma massager made from 100 per cent natural wood. Inspired by the Ayurvedic practice of stimulating Marma points, the item is designed to promote relaxation during travel and is accompanied by a story card explaining its traditional origins.For Premium Economy passengers, Air India has refreshed its amenity kit with a reusable airline-branded bag, hand cream and lip balm from The Indian Apothecary, socks, an eye mask and a story card.The airline is also introducing new loungewear for First and Business Class passengers, drawing on Himachal Pradesh's Kullu shawl-weaving tradition. The gender-neutral collection incorporates geometric motifs through woven detailing on Henley-style tops and bottoms. Available in four sizes, including XXL, each set comes with a bespoke carry bag and a story card explaining the craft inspiration. The airline has also changed the colour of its carpet slippers from grey to beige to complement the new loungewear.
